title: Optimal Transport for Actuarial Science
abstract: arXiv:2610.08797v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: These lecture notes introduce optimal transport as a mathematical language for actuarial science. They treat losses, premiums, scores, reserves, capital scenarios, climate losses and lifetime distributions as probability measures that can be compared, transported, averaged, stressed and interpolated. The first part develops the main tools: couplings, push-forwards, discrete and continuous Kantorovich problems, duality, Wasserstein distances, quantile transport, barycenters, entropic regularization and statistical optimal transport. The second part applies these tools to risk measures, Wasserstein robustness, pricing and capital, portfolio drift, reserving cash-flow distributions, climate-prevention diagnostics, reinsurance, dependence uncertainty, capital allocation, distributional fairness diagnostics and longevity risk. Later chapters and appendices discuss counterfactual transport, dynamic formulations, unbalanced transport, Schr\"odi

translated_title: 精算科学中的最优传输
translated_abstract: 这些讲义将最优传输作为精算科学的一种数学语言加以介绍。它们将损失、保费、评分、准备金、资本情景、气候损失和寿命分布视为概率测度，从而可以对其进行比较、传输、平均、压力测试和插值。第一部分发展了主要工具：耦合、推前映射、离散与连续的Kantorovich问题、对偶性、Wasserstein距离、分位数传输、质心、熵正则化以及统计最优传输。第二部分将这些工具应用于风险度量、Wasserstein稳健性、定价与资本、投资组合漂移、准备金现金流分布、气候防御诊断、再保险、相依性不确定性、资本分配、分布公平性诊断以及长寿风险。后续章节和附录讨论了反事实传输、动态形式、非平衡传输以及薛定谔（Schrödinger）相关内容（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出将最优传输作为统一精算科学的数学语言，系统地把损失、保费、准备金等视为可比较、传输与插值的概率分布，并将其工具（如Wasserstein距离、Kantorovich对偶、质心等）应用于风险度量、定价与资本、再保险、公平性诊断和长寿风险等广泛的精算问题。
en_tdlr: These lecture notes establish optimal transport as a unifying mathematical language for actuarial science, treating losses, premiums, and reserves as probability measures and applying transport tools to risk measures, pricing, capital allocation, reinsurance, fairness diagnostics, and longevity risk.
